ToneOptions.Label: Strategic & Authoritative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Adopt a strategic and authoritative tone, emphasizing foresight and expert guidance.

ToneOptions.Label: Analytical & Prescriptive
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Maintain an analytical and prescriptive tone, focusing on data-driven recommendations and clear actions.

ToneOptions.Label: Integrative & Balanced
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Employ an integrative and balanced tone, highlighting seamless multi-cloud integration and risk mitigation.

ToneOptions.Label: Forward-Looking & Innovative
ToneOptions.FullPhrase: Utilize a forward-looking and innovative tone, showcasing future capabilities and competitive advantages.

GoalOptions.Label: Validate Multi-Cloud Strategy
GoalOptions.Text: The primary goal is to inform and validate the strategic intent behind adopting a multi-cloud approach for AI/ML workloads. Success means stakeholders understand the rationale, benefits, and alignment with overall business objectives, leading to executive endorsement of the proposed strategy.

GoalOptions.Label: Guide Phased Adoption
GoalOptions.Text: This document aims to provide a clear, actionable roadmap for the phased adoption of secondary hyperscalers. Success will be measured by the clarity of the implementation steps, the definition of pilot AI/ML use cases, and the establishment of a structured evaluation framework for AWS and GCP.

GoalOptions.Label: Ensure Governance & Integration
GoalOptions.Text: The objective is to detail how robust governance and seamless integration will be maintained with the existing Azure Landing Zone. Success implies that Lead Engineers and Security Architects are confident in the proposed architecture's ability to uphold security, compliance, and operational consistency across clouds.

GoalOptions.Label: Optimize AI/ML Capabilities
GoalOptions.Text: The goal is to demonstrate how a multi-cloud strategy will unlock specialized compute, enhance scalability, and diversify services specifically for AI/ML and data-intensive workloads. Success means stakeholders recognize the tangible improvements in AI/ML capability and performance, justifying the investment.

CriteriaOptions.Label: Strategic & Business Alignment
Criteria: Does the document clearly articulate the business drivers for multi-cloud adoption?
Are the proposed multi-cloud solutions directly linked to enhancing AI/ML and data-intensive workload capabilities?
Does the strategy align with the client's long-term cloud vision and digital transformation goals?
Is there a compelling case for the ROI and competitive advantage gained from this strategy?

CriteriaOptions.Label: Technical Feasibility & Architecture
Criteria: Is the proposed multi-cloud architecture technically sound and achievable within the client's ecosystem?
Does the document adequately address integration mechanisms with the existing Azure Landing Zone?
Are the considerations for specialized compute, scalability, and service diversity for AI/ML clearly defined?
Does it provide a clear methodology for evaluating and selecting secondary hyperscalers (AWS/GCP)?

CriteriaOptions.Label: Governance, Security & Operations
Criteria: Does the strategy ensure robust governance, security, and compliance across all cloud environments?
Are the operational impacts and management complexities of a multi-cloud setup sufficiently addressed?
Does the document outline how data residency, access control, and network security will be managed?
Is there a clear plan for monitoring, cost management, and incident response in the multi-cloud environment?
